--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.productsubcategory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Product subcategories. See ProductCategory table.
Fields:
  - productsubcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier that uniquely represents each product subcategory within the system
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the subcategory record was last modified for audit and synchronization purposes
  - name (character varying(50)): The business name of the product subcategory (e.g., Mountain Bikes, Road Frames, Touring Bicycles)
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and data synchronization across systems
  - productcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the parent product category, establishing the hierarchical relationship between category and subcategory
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.purchasing.purchaseorderheader ---
Domain: Procurement
Description: General purchase order information. See PurchaseOrderDetail.
Fields:
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the purchase order was originally created and submitted to the vendor
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code representing the current lifecycle stage of the purchase order (e.g., pending, approved, received, closed)
  - vendorid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the vendor/supplier from whom goods or services are being procured
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this purchase order record
  - subtotal (numeric): Total monetary value of all line items before taxes, shipping, and other charges
  - employeeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the employee who initiated or approved the purchase order
  - taxamt (numeric): Total tax amount applied to the purchase order based on applicable tax rates and jurisdictions
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier for the shipping carrier and method used (e.g., ground, express, freight)
  - revisionnumber (smallint(16,0)): Version indicator tracking the number of times this purchase order has been modified, enabling change history and audit trails
  - freight (numeric): Shipping and handling costs associated with transporting goods from vendor to organization
  - purchaseorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each purchase order, serving as the primary key for referencing and tracking individual orders
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the ordered goods were shipped or are scheduled to ship from the vendor
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.productcosthistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the cost of a product over time.
Fields:
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The last date when this cost version was effective; after this date, a new cost superseded this record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when this cost record was last updated or modified in the system
  - standardcost (numeric): The monetary value representing the standard cost of the product during this effective period
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The first date when this cost version became effective and was used for valuation purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product for which this cost history record applies
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.production.product ---
Domain: Product
Description: Products sold or used in the manfacturing of sold products.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each product in the catalog, serving as the primary key for product-related transactions and relationships
  - sellstartdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when the product became available for sale, marking the beginning of the product's active sales lifecycle
  - weight (numeric(8,2)): Physical weight of the product used for shipping calculations, inventory tracking, and freight cost estimation
  - sellenddate (timestamp without time zone): Date when the product was removed from active sales, indicating the end of the product's market availability
  - weightunitmeasurecode (character(3)) [FK]: Unit of measurement for the product weight, such as LB (pounds) or KG (kilograms), ensuring consistent weight interpretation
  - standardcost (numeric): Baseline cost used for inventory valuation, margin calculation, and standard costing accounting purposes
  - style (character(2)): Product style classification code that categorizes products by style variant for segmentation and reporting
  - makeflag (boolean): Boolean indicator showing whether the product is manufactured in-house (true) or purchased from external vendors (false)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the product record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization
  - finishedgoodsflag (boolean): Boolean flag indicating if the product is a finished good ready for customer sale versus a raw material or component
  - productsubcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key linking to the product subcategory classification, enabling hierarchical product categorization
  - productmodelid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the product model specification, linking to detailed model and engineering information
  - productline (character(2)): Product line code classifying products into product families such as R (Road), M (Mountain), or T (Touring) for marketing and reporting
  - safetystocklevel (smallint(16,0)): Minimum inventory buffer quantity to prevent stockouts during lead times, protecting against demand variability
  - size (character varying(5)): Product size attribute for items like clothing, footwear, or equipment where size is relevant to customer selection
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.production.transactionhistory ---
Domain: Inventory
Description: Record of each purchase order, sales order, or work order transaction year to date.
Fields:
  - transactiontype (character(1)): Single-character code indicating the type of transaction (e.g., P for Purchase, S for Sales, W for Work Order)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp when the transaction record was last updated or modified in the system
  - quantity (integer(32,0)): Number of units involved in the transaction for the associated product
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Unique identifier referencing the product being transacted in this record
  - transactionid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique identifier for each individual transaction record
  - referenceorderid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the parent order (purchase, sales, or work order) that initiated this transaction
  - transactiondate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the actual transaction occurred in the business process
  - actualcost (numeric): Real monetary cost incurred for the transaction, used for financial reporting and cost analysis
  - referenceorderlineid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the specific line item within the parent order, allowing granular transaction tracking
Match reason: Source: vector
